headline.title: Last 24 hours to get 50% off a second pass to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
headline.summary: TechCrunch is offering a limited-time promotion where attendees can purchase one pass to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 and receive a second pass at 50% off. This offer is available for the last 24 hours, encouraging participants to bring a partner, co-founder, or colleague.

articles.title: See what happens when creative legends use AI to make ads for small businesses.
articles.summary: Creative legends Susan Credle, Jayonta Jenkins, and Tiffany Rolfe collaborated to utilize AI in producing advertisements for small businesses. The project showcases innovative approaches to marketing by blending human creativity with artificial intelligence technology.

articles.title: Cloudflare says AI made 1,100 jobs obsolete, even as revenue hit a record high
articles.summary: Cloudflare's CEO Matthew Prince announced that the company has made 1,100 jobs obsolete due to efficiency gains from AI, marking its first large-scale layoff. Despite this reduction in workforce, Cloudflare reported record-high revenue.

articles.title: CyberSecQwen-4B: Why Defensive Cyber Needs Small, Specialized, Locally-Runnable Models
articles.summary: The article discusses the development of CyberSecQwen-4B, a specialized AI model designed for defensive cybersecurity applications. It emphasizes the importance of small, locally-runnable models to enhance security measures and address specific threats in a targeted manner.

articles.title: Intel’s comeback story is even wilder than it seems
articles.summary: Intel's stock has surged 490% over the past year, reflecting strong investor confidence in the company's potential recovery. However, analysts caution that this optimism may be outpacing the reality of Intel's actual turnaround progress.

articles.title: PlayStation sees AI as a ‘powerful tool’ to help make games
articles.summary: Sony's recent earnings presentation highlighted its view of AI as a valuable asset in game development for PlayStation. The company is exploring the integration of generative AI in its games, despite some resistance from indie developers.

articles.title: Microsoft was worried OpenAI would run off to Amazon and ‘shit-talk’ Azure
articles.summary: Court documents from the Musk v. Altman trial reveal that Microsoft executives, including CEO Satya Nadella, were concerned about OpenAI potentially collaborating with Amazon and criticizing Azure during the early stages of their partnership. The communications highlight the strategic considerations Microsoft faced while investing in OpenAI amid competitive pressures in the AI landscape.

articles.title: The “people’s airline” and the enterprise AI gold rush
articles.summary: This week, several companies, including Anthropic and OpenAI, announced new initiatives aimed at enhancing enterprise AI deployment, while SAP invested $1 billion in German AI startup Prior Labs. The growing interest in enterprise AI tools suggests that startups in this sector are increasingly seen as potential acquisition targets.

articles.title: EMO: Pretraining mixture of experts for emergent modularity
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced EMO, a pretraining approach that utilizes a mixture of experts to enhance modularity in AI models. This method aims to improve the efficiency and adaptability of AI systems by allowing them to dynamically select specialized components for different tasks.

articles.title: Running Codex safely at OpenAI
articles.summary: OpenAI employs sandboxing, approval processes, network policies, and agent-native telemetry to ensure the secure operation of Codex. These measures are designed to facilitate the safe and compliant adoption of coding agents.

articles.title: Nick Bostrom Has a Plan for Humanity’s ‘Big Retirement’
articles.summary: Philosopher Nick Bostrom advocates for the development of advanced AI as a means to achieve a "solved world," suggesting that humanity should focus on this pursuit as a form of preparation for a future "Big Retirement." He believes that leveraging AI could lead to significant advancements that enhance human life and address global challenges.

articles.title: There’s a Long-Shot Proposal to Protect California Workers From AI
articles.summary: California gubernatorial candidate Tom Steyer has introduced a proposal for a jobs guarantee aimed at protecting workers who are displaced by artificial intelligence. The initiative seeks to address the potential impact of AI on employment in the state.
